newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ELBER HOPES TO WIN BRAZIL PLACE AT BAYERN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ELBER HOPES TO WIN BRAZIL PLACE AT BAYERN.

text.p: Striker Giovane Elber hopes his move to Bayern Munich from VfB Stuttgart will enhance his chance of selection in Brazil's squad for the 1998 World Cup in France.
"I hope that I can draw attention to myself with lots of goals in the Bayern shirt and then be there for the World Cup in France," Elber told the German Sports magazine published on Tuesday.
"As long as I play in Stuttgart hardly anyone in Brazil takes any notice of me... But every child at home has heard of Bayern," he said.
The transfer fee for Elber, who has scored 16 German league goals this season, is expected to be more than 10 million marks ($5.8 million).
Vfb Stuttgart said on Monday Elber was leaving the club and Nigerian Jonathan Akpoborie, who currently plays for Hansa Rostock, would replace him.
Elber is expected to slot into Juergen Klinsmann's position at Bayern.
The Germany captain has decided to leave the club at the end of the season, although he has yet to decide where he will go. Italy's Parma are among the possibilities.
